create_categorical_distribution: create a Categorical nn.Module that maps inputs to action logits and masks unavailable actions
create_diagaussian_distribution: create a DiagGaussian nn.Module that outputs a diagonal Gaussian distribution over continuous actions
create_bernoulli_distribution: create a Bernoulli nn.Module that maps inputs to Bernoulli logits for binary action spaces
use_fixedcategorical_log_probs: use FixedCategorical to compute log probabilities of sampled actions with proper shape handling
use_addbias_module: use AddBias to add a learnable bias parameter to tensors with automatic shape broadcasting
